name: us4-recorded-value-outside-allowed
description: 015, US4 (contract §6): a recorded field default outside its field's enumerated allowed_values refuses the configuration ceremony, naming the label, the type, and the accepted values — never the recorded value — and writes nothing. Uses the same option-typed fixture as US1/US2, with the specification role's Region default hand-edited to a value the mock's createmeta never lists.
